description: Insulation contractor in Oakland, CA serving Montclair, Rockridge, hilly East Oakland and the flats from our San Leandro base. Book a free inspection.
intro: East Bay Insulation serves Oakland from our San Leandro base, about 8 miles south via I-880. Our crews work across hilly East Oakland and the flats, Montclair, Rockridge and the downtown core, planning each job around the neighborhood and the house.

paragraphs: Oakland packs steep hillside streets and flatland tracts into one city. Homes in Montclair and hilly East Oakland sit on sloping lots, the flats hold older frame houses, and the downtown core mixes houses and apartments.
Because one Oakland block rarely looks like the next, every job starts with a free inspection. We plan the attic, walls and crawl space around the actual house before quoting a number.

sections.h2: What Oakland homeowners call us for
bullets: Attic insulation and air sealing in hillside and flatland homes
Crawl space encapsulation and vapor barriers
Rodent proofing and exclusion before reinsulation
Insulation removal and replacement before remodels
Spray foam for rim joists and open ceilings

sections.h2: From San Leandro to your door
paragraphs: We run the 8 miles up I-880 from our San Leandro base, so inspections are quick to schedule and follow-up visits are easy. The estimate is free, it is written down, and the crew that inspects your home does the work.

faqs.q: How quickly can you get to Oakland?
faqs.a: Oakland is about 8 miles from our San Leandro base via I-880, so most inspections happen within the same week you call.

faqs.q: Do you work in the Oakland hills?
faqs.a: Yes. We serve hilly East Oakland, Montclair and Rockridge as well as the flats and downtown, and sloping lots are part of the plan from the first visit.

faqs.q: What should Oakland homeowners check first?
faqs.a: The attic and the crawl space are usually where Oakland homes lose the most heat. The free inspection shows where air and moisture are getting in.
